name: Rome
notes: Rome AI Lab's open-source agentic OS: a personal agent reachable on Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Lark and WeChat, plus an app store and developer platform. Self-host free on a Mac; hosted Pro $20/mo, Max $40/mo; hosted access is private preview by invitation. Comparable to OpenClaw. Requested via the form (issue #307).
tagline: An open-source agentic OS you chat with on Telegram or WhatsApp
